design_additions.requirement: The Schedule plugin requires SessionProjectionRegistry; absent provider or key is a fail-closed composition/capability error and must never become a corrupt-log or ordinary internal tool result. Runtime unavailable-state diagnostics must be distinct from corrupt-log diagnostics.

assertions: Schedule composition rejects a missing SessionProjectionRegistry before runtime/tool registration.
A missing schedule key is surfaced as a composition/capability failure and is not converted to corrupt_schedule_log or internal_error.
A missing schedule key faults/stops the runtime with a distinct unavailable-projection diagnostic, not a corrupt-log diagnostic.

design_additions.requirement: Preserve package-attributed InvariantError for invalid creation baselines: register a prepend global session/created preflight that transiently applies scheduleProjectionDefinition from exact inheritedEventCount over SessionCreationBaseline.events; catch only ScheduleLogError and call fail(). After the projection registry initializes, retain a post-projection stateOf check. Do not use ownEvents or snapshotEvents.

Prove shared key refcounting through both contributor disposal orders. With Schedule and schedule-invariant registered, disposing either contributor must leave the other able to read exact state and perform its applicable runtime/pre-append role; disposing the final contributor removes the key.

Prove live restore and fork behavior: assert inheritedEventCount, active and seenIds after persisted resume; assert terminal IDs remain reserved; and exercise an inherited-only fork runtime that does not flush or wake while an owned suffix remains visible and operative.
